head: codex/5835-wp17-continuity-migration
title: [v0.92][WP-17] Migration and cross-polis continuity planning
body:
Closes danielbaustin/agent-design-language#5835

## Outcome

Defines an 11-row, documentation-only continuity-transfer contract over landed v0.92 Birthday evidence. Proposal fields remain untrusted until they match provisioned repository, revision, authority-context, redaction-policy, and replacement ACIP anchors.

## Proof

- binds ACIP authority to agent-logic/agent-design-language#209, PR #215, merge a77519c3, and digest-pinned local/native manifests
- retains six rejected transfer cases and eight mutation-negative checks
- verifies rollback against exact base 1567469e using before/after digests, restore/delete simulation, byte-identical read-only handoff, retained evidence, and preserved upstream authority
- focused positive proof: 11 matrix rows, 11 landed schemas, dependencies #5826/#5827/#5834, trusted authority #209, six rollback cases
- fresh independent exact-head review of 1d765ecfd61fcd7bccd50b37d0dc660a8ccf9f43: APPROVED with no findings

## Boundaries

No Runtime, storage, networking, production migration, federation, citizenship, standing, rights, or governance implementation is claimed. The v0.93 handoff remains byte-identical and read-only.
